text_en: King David was old and advanced in years; and although they covered him with clothes, he could not get warm.
text_cn: 达味王年纪已老，虽然盖着许多被褥，仍然不觉温暖。

text_en: So his servants said to him, “Let a young virgin be sought for my lord the king, and let her wait on the king, and be his attendant; let her lie in your bosom, so that my lord the king may be warm. ”
text_cn: 于是他的臣仆对他说：“让人为我主大王找一个年轻少女来，服侍大王，照料大王，睡在大王怀里，温暖我主大王。”

text_en: So they searched for a beautiful girl throughout all the territory of Israel, and found Abishag the Shunammite, and brought her to the king.
text_cn: 他们就在以色列全境，寻找美丽的少女；找着了一个叔能女子阿彼沙格，便领她到君王那里。

text_en: The girl was very beautiful. She became the king’s attendant and served him, but the king did not know her sexually.
text_cn: 这少女非常美丽，她就照料服侍君王，君王却没有认识她。

text_en: Now Adonijah son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, “I will be king”; he prepared for himself chariots and horsemen, and fifty men to run before him.
text_cn: 那时，哈基特的儿子阿多尼雅自尊自大说：“我必要作王！”他遂为自己预备了车辆和骑兵，有五十人在他前面开道。

text_en: His father had never at any time displeased him by asking, “Why have you done thus and so? ” He was also a very handsome man, and he was born next after Absalom.
text_cn: 他的父亲一生从未责骂过他说：“你为什么这样做？”他出生于阿贝沙隆之后，也是个十分英俊的人。

text_en: He conferred with Joab son of Zeruiah and with the priest Abiathar, and they supported Adonijah.
text_cn: 他曾与责鲁雅的儿子约阿布和司祭厄贝雅塔尔商议过，他们二人都支持阿多尼雅。

text_en: But the priest Zadok, and Benaiah son of Jehoiada, and the prophet Nathan, and Shimei, and Rei, and David’s own warriors did not side with Adonijah.
text_cn: 但是司祭匝多克、约雅达的儿子贝纳雅、先知纳堂、史米、勒依，以及达味的勇士们，都不拥护阿多尼雅。

text_en: Adonijah sacrificed sheep, oxen, and fatted cattle by the stone Zoheleth, which is beside En-rogel, and he invited all his brothers, the king’s sons, and all the royal officials of Judah,
text_cn: 一天，阿多尼雅在洛革耳泉旁的左赫肋特磐石上，宰杀了牛羊和肥犊，邀请了君王的儿子们──他所有的兄弟，和所有作君王臣仆的犹大人，

text_en: but he did not invite the prophet Nathan or Benaiah or the warriors or his brother Solomon.
text_cn: 惟独没有邀请先知纳堂、贝纳雅、勇士们和他的兄弟撒罗满。

text_en: Then Nathan said to Bathsheba, Solomon’s mother, “Have you not heard that Adonijah son of Haggith has become king and our lord David does not know it?
text_cn: 纳堂对撒罗满的母亲巴特舍巴说：“你没有听说：哈基特的儿子阿多尼雅已作了王，而我们的主上达味还不知道吗？

text_en: Now therefore come, let me give you advice, so that you may save your own life and the life of your son Solomon.
text_cn: 现在，我给你出个主意，好保全你和你儿子撒罗满的性命。

text_en: Go in at once to King David, and say to him, ‘Did you not, my lord the king, swear to your servant, saying: Your son Solomon shall succeed me as king, and he shall sit on my throne? Why then is Adonijah king? ’
text_cn: 你去见达味，对他说：我主大王，你不是曾向你的婢女起誓说：你的儿子撒罗满必要继我为王，坐上我的宝座吗？为什么阿多尼雅却作了王呢？

text_en: Then while you are still there speaking with the king, I will come in after you and confirm your words. ”
text_cn: 当你还在那里与君王说话时，我便随后进来，证实你的话。”

text_en: So Bathsheba went to the king in his room. The king was very old; Abishag the Shunammite was attending the king.
text_cn: 巴特舍巴于是进了君王的内室。君王年纪已老，叔能女子阿彼沙格正在旁服侍君王。

text_en: Bathsheba bowed and did obeisance to the king, and the king said, “What do you wish? ”
text_cn: 巴特舍巴便俯伏叩拜君王。君王问说：“你有什么事？”

text_en: She said to him, “My lord, you swore to your servant by the Lord your God, saying: Your son Solomon shall succeed me as king, and he shall sit on my throne.
text_cn: 巴特舍巴答说：“我主，你曾指着上主你的天主向你的婢女起誓说：你的儿子撒罗满必要继我为王，坐上我的宝座。

text_en: But now suddenly Adonijah has become king, though you, my lord the king, do not know it.
text_cn: 但是，现在阿多尼雅已作了王，而我主大王，你还不知道。

text_en: He has sacrificed oxen, fatted cattle, and sheep in abundance, and has invited all the children of the king, the priest Abiathar, and Joab the commander of the army; but your servant Solomon he has not invited.
text_cn: 他宰杀了许多牛、肥犊和羊，邀请了君王所有的儿子和厄贝雅塔尔司祭并约阿布元帅，惟独你的仆人撒罗满，他没有邀请。

text_en: But you, my lord the king—the eyes of all Israel are on you to tell them who shall sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.
text_cn: 我主大王，现在全以色列人的眼望着你，等待你通告他们，谁要坐上我主大王的宝座，继承大王。

text_en: Otherwise it will come to pass, when my lord the king sleeps with his ancestors, that my son Solomon and I will be counted offenders. ”
text_cn: 不然，将来我主大王同自己的祖先长眠之后，我和我的儿子撒罗满必被列为罪犯。”

text_en: While she was still speaking with the king, the prophet Nathan came in.
text_cn: 正当她同君王谈话时，纳堂先知进来了。

text_en: The king was told, “Here is the prophet Nathan. ” When he came in before the king, he did obeisance to the king, with his face to the ground.
text_cn: 有人禀告君王说：“纳堂先知来了。”他来到君王面前，便俯首至地，向君王下拜。

text_en: Nathan said, “My lord the king, have you said, ‘Adonijah shall succeed me as king, and he shall sit on my throne’?
text_cn: 纳堂说：“我主大王，想必你说过，阿多尼雅必要继我为王，坐上我的宝座。

text_en: For today he has gone down and has sacrificed oxen, fatted cattle, and sheep in abundance, and has invited all the king’s children, Joab the commander of the army, and the priest Abiathar, who are now eating and drinking before him, and saying, ‘Long live King Adonijah! ’
text_cn: 因为他今天下去，宰杀了许多牛、肥犊和羊，邀请了君王所有的儿子和军官，以及厄贝雅塔尔司祭；他们在他面前吃喝，呼喊说：阿多尼雅王万岁！

text_en: But he did not invite me, your servant, and the priest Zadok, and Benaiah son of Jehoiada, and your servant Solomon.
text_cn: 至于你的仆人我、匝多克司祭、约雅达的儿子贝纳雅，以及你的儿子撒罗满，他都没有邀请。

text_en: Has this thing been brought about by my lord the king and you have not let your servants know who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him? ”
text_cn: 如果这事是出于我主大王，难道你会不通告你的仆人，谁要坐上我主大王的宝座，继承大王吗？”

text_en: King David answered, “Summon Bathsheba to me. ” So she came into the king’s presence, and stood before the king.
text_cn: 达味回答说：“快给我召巴特舍巴来！”她便进来立在君王面前。

text_en: The king swore, saying, “As the Lord lives, who has saved my life from every adversity,
text_cn: 君王起誓说：“救我脱离各种患难的上主永在！

text_en: as I swore to you by the Lord , the God of Israel, ‘Your son Solomon shall succeed me as king, and he shall sit on my throne in my place, ’ so will I do this day. ”
text_cn: 我既然曾指着上主以色列的天主向你起誓说：你的儿子撒罗满必要继我为王，代我坐上我的宝座：今天我就要这样作。”

text_en: Then Bathsheba bowed with her face to the ground, and did obeisance to the king, and said, “May my lord King David live forever! ”
text_cn: 巴特舍巴遂俯伏在地，叩拜君王说：“愿我主大王达味万岁！”

text_en: King David said, “Summon to me the priest Zadok, the prophet Nathan, and Benaiah son of Jehoiada. ” When they came before the king,
text_cn: 达味王接着说：“将司祭匝多克、先知纳堂、约雅达的儿子贝纳雅，给我召来。”他们都来到君王面前。

text_en: the king said to them, “Take with you the servants of your lord, and have my son Solomon ride on my own mule, and bring him down to Gihon.
text_cn: 君王对他们说：“率领你们主子的仆人，立刻叫我儿撒罗满骑上我自己的骡子，护送他下到基红去。

text_en: There let the priest Zadok and the prophet Nathan anoint him king over Israel; then blow the trumpet, and say, ‘Long live King Solomon! ’
text_cn: 司祭匝多克和先知纳堂要在那里给他傅油，立他为以色列王。你们要吹号欢呼说：撒罗满王万岁！

text_en: You shall go up following him. Let him enter and sit on my throne; he shall be king in my place; for I have appointed him to be ruler over Israel and over Judah. ”
text_cn: 以后，你们跟他上来，他要来坐我的宝座，继位为王，因为我已钦定他作以色列和犹大的领袖。”

text_en: Benaiah son of Jehoiada answered the king, “Amen! May the Lord , the God of my lord the king, so ordain.
text_cn: 约雅达的儿子贝纳雅回答君王说：“但愿如此！愿我主大王的上主天主，如此照准！

text_en: As the Lord has been with my lord the king, so may he be with Solomon, and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord King David. ”
text_cn: 上主如何与我主大王同在，也愿他与撒罗满同在！使他的王位高于我主君王达味的王位。”

text_en: So the priest Zadok, the prophet Nathan, and Benaiah son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites, went down and had Solomon ride on King David’s mule, and led him to Gihon.
text_cn: 于是司祭匝多克、先知纳堂、约雅达的儿子贝纳雅、革勒提人和培肋提人下去，叫撒罗满骑上达味王的骡子，护送他到了基红。

text_en: There the priest Zadok took the horn of oil from the tent and anointed Solomon. Then they blew the trumpet, and all the people said, “Long live King Solomon! ”
text_cn: 司祭匝多克从会幕里取过油角来，给撒罗满傅了油，人们立即吹号，众百姓一起欢呼说：“撒罗满王万岁！”

text_en: And all the people went up following him, playing on pipes and rejoicing with great joy, so that the earth quaked at their noise.
text_cn: 以后，所有的人民拥护他上去，吹着笛子，尽情欢喜，以致大地也因他们的欢呼声而震动了。

text_en: Adonijah and all the guests who were with him heard it as they finished feasting. When Joab heard the sound of the trumpet, he said, “Why is the city in an uproar? ”
text_cn: 阿多尼雅和他所请的一切客人欢宴刚完，都听见了这声音；约阿布一听见号声，便问说：“为什么城中这样鼓噪？”

text_en: While he was still speaking, Jonathan son of the priest Abiathar arrived. Adonijah said, “Come in, for you are a worthy man and surely you bring good news. ”
text_cn: 他正说话的时候，司祭厄贝雅塔尔的儿子约纳堂来了，阿多尼雅说：“进来，你是个英雄好汉，想必带来了好消息！”

text_en: Jonathan answered Adonijah, “No, for our lord King David has made Solomon king;
text_cn: 约纳堂回答阿多尼雅说：“不！我们的主上达味王已立撒罗满为王了。

text_en: the king has sent with him the priest Zadok, the prophet Nathan, and Benaiah son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and they had him ride on the king’s mule;
text_cn: 君王派司祭匝多克、先知纳堂、约雅达的儿子贝纳雅、革勒提人和培肋提人，护送他下去，叫他骑上了君王的骡子。

text_en: the priest Zadok and the prophet Nathan have anointed him king at Gihon; and they have gone up from there rejoicing, so that the city is in an uproar. This is the noise that you heard.
text_cn: 司祭匝多克和先知纳堂已在基红给他傅了油，立他为王。现在他们正从那里欢呼上来，震动了全城：这就是你们听到的喧嚷声。

text_en: Solomon now sits on the royal throne.
text_cn: 撒罗满现已坐上了君王的宝座，

text_en: Moreover the king’s servants came to congratulate our lord King David, saying, ‘May God make the name of Solomon more famous than yours, and make his throne greater than your throne. ’ The king bowed in worship on the bed
text_cn: 君王的臣仆都来祝贺我们的主上达味王说：愿你的天主使撒罗满的名声比你的名声更荣耀，使他的王位比你的王位更兴隆！君王就伏在床上下拜，

text_en: and went on to pray thus, ‘Blessed be the Lord , the God of Israel, who today has granted one of my offspring to sit on my throne and permitted me to witness it. ’”
text_cn: 且说：上主以色列的天主应受赞美！因为今天他指派了一个人坐上我的宝座，我也亲眼看见了。”

text_en: Then all the guests of Adonijah got up trembling and went their own ways.
text_cn: 阿多尼雅请来的客人都害了怕，起来各自走了。

text_en: Adonijah, fearing Solomon, got up and went to grasp the horns of the altar.
text_cn: 阿多尼雅也害怕撒罗满，遂起来跑到上主的会幕内，抱住祭坛的角。

text_en: Solomon was informed, “Adonijah is afraid of King Solomon; see, he has laid hold of the horns of the altar, saying, ‘Let King Solomon swear to me first that he will not kill his servant with the sword. ’”
text_cn: 有人告诉撒罗满说：“看，阿多尼雅害怕撒罗满王，抱住祭坛的角说：撒罗满王先得向我起誓：决不用刀杀死他的仆人。”

text_en: So Solomon responded, “If he proves to be a worthy man, not one of his hairs shall fall to the ground; but if wickedness is found in him, he shall die. ”
text_cn: 撒罗满说：“如果他肯做一个忠义的人，他的一根头发也不会落在地上；但如果发现他有什么不对，必死无疑。”

text_en: Then King Solomon sent to have him brought down from the altar. He came to do obeisance to King Solomon; and Solomon said to him, “Go home. ”
text_cn: 撒罗满王遂派人去，叫他从祭坛上下来；他便前来，俯伏在撒罗满王前。撒罗满对他说：“你回家去吧！”
